summary_en: Ikuyo Corporation (code: 7273, TSE Standard Market) has announced plans to launch a public tender offer for all ordinary shares of Muraki Corporation. Muraki received no prior notice and will review disclosure documents and related information before deciding its response.
title_en: Notice Regarding Planned Commencement of Public Tender Offer for Our Shares by Ikuyo Corporation
translation_en_brief:
On October 26, 2026, Muraki Corporation announced that Ikuyo Corporation (TSE Standard Market, code 7273) has publicly announced plans to commence a tender offer for all ordinary shares of Muraki. Ikuyo is the acquirer and Muraki is the target company. The tender offer is unsolicited; Muraki had received no advance notice from Ikuyo prior to the public announcement.

Muraki stated that it will review the disclosure documents and related information concerning the tender offer before determining its response and position. The company emphasized that this notice does not express an opinion on the tender offer. Muraki's opinion and recommendation will be announced separately after the company reaches a decision.

In a prior disclosure dated September 24, 2026, Muraki had already announced that it recognized Ikuyo's coordination with Blue Goats Capital as constituting a "coordinated action" under Muraki's defensive policy on large-scale share purchases, which had been approved by shareholders at Muraki's 67th Annual General Meeting. Specific details of that prior recognition were published in a separate press release.
